name: How The Snow Lands
source:
You've fallen down in the forest after getting lost while on your way to visit a friend. You're suffering from severe frostbite and hypothermia and cannot stand up. Suddenly, a girl approaches you from the forest.

[From [url=https://tangledhearts.itch.io/how-the-snow-lands]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在拜访朋友的路上迷路后跌倒在森林里。你患有严重冻伤和体温过低，无法站立。突然，一个女孩从森林里向你走来。

[来自[url=https://tangledhearts.itch.io/how-the-snow-lands]itch.io[/url]]
